response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), m AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(a.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mean_rate) AS avg_excess FROM album_rates a, m WHERE a.rate > m.mean_rate
